meta.source: shadcn/ui create preset b3JSmtB71E, adapted — Luma · Mist · Emerald · Teal charts · JetBrains Mono headings · Inter · Phosphor · radius 8px (preset: 0.625rem) · Base UI

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and app-window ground. Carries `foreground` text.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `muted`, `accent` and `sidebar` (≥17:1 light, ≥14:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card, panel and inspector surfaces.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Emerald. The one main action per view, checked controls, active switch. As a fill only in dark — for emerald text use `link`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a `primary` fill (5.1:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: ADDED. Emerald text: links and the link button. On `background`, `card` and `muted` (≥4.8:1 light, ≥5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, the dialog close button. Mist 100 / Mist 800, the same step as `muted`.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (15.6:1 light, 14.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: tabs track, hover rows, kbd, progress track, outline/ghost button hover.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text — descriptions, placeholders, metadata — on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `sidebar` (≥4.7:1 light, ≥6:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlighted menu item, focused option, active sidebar item.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete, discard, invalid. Never a solid fill: text and icon in `destructive` on a 10% (light) / 20% (dark) tint of itself (≥4.8:1 on the tint over `background`, ≥4.5:1 over `card`, ≥5.3:1 on `background`).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rows, separators, outline buttons. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Control fill: inputs, selects and textareas paint it at 50%, checkboxes and the off switch at 90%. Luma controls have no visible border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a solid 2px outline, offset 2px. ≥3:1 on `background`, `card` and `muted` in both themes (3.9 / 3.5 light, 4.3 / 3.2 dark).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (lightest teal). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (darkest teal). A sequential ramp: use for ordered data; label series directly rather than by hue alone.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar and the desktop tree pane.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar`; group labels at 70%.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Sidebar brand chip / active marker. Light equals `primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary` (5.1:1 light, 6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered / active sidebar row.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge and separators.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar — an alias of `ring`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: ADDED. Success text and icon on `background`, `card` and `success-muted` (≥6:1 both themes). Always with a check icon and a word — it sits close to `primary` and differs from `destructive` by hue.

tokens.name: success-muted
tokens.usage: ADDED. Tint behind success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: ADDED. Text on a solid `success` fill (6.8:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: ADDED. Warning text and icon on `background`, `card` and `warning-muted` (≥6:1). Always with a warning icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-muted
tokens.usage: ADDED. Tint behind warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: ADDED. Text on a solid `warning` fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: ADDED. Informational text and icon on `background`, `card` and `info-muted` (≥5:1). Not for links.

tokens.name: info-muted
tokens.usage: ADDED. Tint behind info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: ADDED. Text on a solid `info` fill.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: ADDED. Hover fill of the default (primary) button: `primary` at 80%.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: ADDED. Hover fill of the secondary button: `secondary` mixed 5% toward `foreground` (opaque).

tokens.name: muted-hover
tokens.usage: ADDED. Quiet hover fill: table rows, toggles, the open or current navigation item. `muted` at 50%.

tokens.name: ghost-hover
tokens.usage: ADDED. Hover fill of the ghost button: `muted` in light, `muted` at 50% in dark.

tokens.name: outline-hover
tokens.usage: ADDED. Hover fill of the outline button: `muted` in light, `input` at 30% in dark.

tokens.name: tab-active
tokens.usage: ADDED. Fill of the selected tab: `background` in light, `input` at 30% in dark.

tokens.name: tab-foreground
tokens.usage: ADDED. Label colour of an unselected tab: `foreground` at 60%.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: ADDED. Fill of inputs, selects, textareas and input groups: `input` at 50%.

tokens.name: control-strong
tokens.usage: ADDED. Unchecked checkbox fill and the switch track when off: `input` at 90%.

tokens.name: kbd
tokens.usage: ADDED. Fill of a kbd chip sitting inside an input group: `muted-foreground` at 10%.

tokens.name: destructive-muted
tokens.usage: ADDED. Tint behind the destructive button, badge, menu item and diff removals — completes the `*-muted` set (10% light, 20% dark).

tokens.name: destructive-muted-hover
tokens.usage: ADDED. Hover fill on a `destructive-muted` surface (20% light, 30% dark).

tokens.name: invalid-ring
tokens.usage: ADDED. 3px ring around an invalid input or select (20% light, 40% dark).

tokens.name: invalid-border
tokens.usage: ADDED. Border of an invalid input: none in light, `destructive` at 50% in dark.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: ADDED. Scrim behind dialogs and sheets. Pair it with an 8px background blur where the platform has one.

tokens.name: outline-fill
tokens.usage: ADDED. Fill of the outline button: `background` in light, transparent in dark.

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: ADDED. Switch thumb when off: `background` in light, `foreground` in dark.

tokens.name: switch-thumb-checked
tokens.usage: ADDED. Switch thumb when on: `background` in light, `primary-foreground` in dark.

styles.name: heading-2xl
styles.usage: ADDED. Page title, one per view — including blog post and doc titles.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: ADDED. Section title, and `h2` inside long-form articles.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Alert-dialog and empty-state title (Luma); `h3` inside long-form articles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: The quick brown fox — 다람쥐 헌 쳇바퀴에 타고파.
styles.usage: Input text under 768px (prevents iOS zoom); long reading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pushed 3 commits to main · 커밋 3개를 푸시했습니다.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, menu items, tabs, field labels, table heads.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: ADDED. Commit SHAs, paths, SQL, cell values, code.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: ADDED. Inline refs and IDs inside compact rows.

styles.name: mono-ko
styles.usage: ADDED. Monospaced text that mixes Hangul and must stay column-aligned (diffs, data grids, logs): D2Coding only, whose Hangul is exactly two Latin cells wide.

styles.name: compact-body
styles.usage: ADDED. Desktop (Slint) list, tree and grid rows.

styles.name: compact-label
styles.usage: ADDED. Desktop toolbar buttons, pane headers, column heads.

styles.name: serif-body
styles.sample: A branch is a movable pointer to a commit. 브랜치는 커밋을 가리키는 움직이는 포인터입니다.
styles.usage: ADDED. Reading text in blog posts, docs and release notes; measure 60–75 characters.

styles.name: serif-quote
styles.sample: Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
styles.usage: ADDED. Pull quotes and epigraphs (MaruBuri has no italic, so Hangul stays upright).

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px step (--spacing: .25rem). Names follow the multiplier.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tabs-list padding, badge gap, tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, menu content padding, card-header gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Menu item vertical padding, dialog footer gap, compact row padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Menu item icon gap, xs button padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding, table cell padding, alert block padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Alert inline padding, small-card padding, dialog close inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap (`--card-spacing`).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: A tighter scale on an 8px base. Controls default to `radius`; `radius-full` is the opt-in pill shape.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tooltip arrow, diff markers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox, kbd, compact tree rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tooltip, compact buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base. Buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, input groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Diff and code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists, popovers, alerts, the desktop window.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, switches and tabs; the opt-in `pill` shape for buttons, inputs, selects and input groups.

shadow.note: Luma pairs a 1px foreground ring with a Tailwind shadow instead of a border.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, selects, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: ADDED. Hover state of an interactive card: the ring doubles (5% to 10% light, 10% to 20% dark).

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: ADDED. Selected tab thumb.

size.note: Control and row heights. `comfortable` is Web (Luma, exact); `compact` is an ADDED desktop density for Slint tools.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: xs button, icon-xs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: sm button, sm select.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select, tabs list, menu item.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: lg button.

tokens.name: table-head
tokens.usage: Table header row (comfortable).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in badges, kbd, xs buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon in buttons, inputs, menus, alerts.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Toolbar icons (desktop), empty-state media at 32px.

tokens.name: compact-control
tokens.usage: ADDED. Desktop buttons, inputs, selects, toolbar items.

tokens.name: compact-row
tokens.usage: ADDED. Desktop list, tree and data-grid rows.

tokens.name: compact-head
tokens.usage: ADDED. Desktop grid header and pane header.

tokens.name: compact-pad
tokens.usage: ADDED. Desktop control and cell horizontal padding.
